title: C. An impassioned circulation of affection

legend: Nadeko's birthday is approaching! As she decorated the room for the party, a long garland of Dianthus-shaped paper pieces was placed on a prominent part of the wall. Brother Koyomi will like it!

Still unsatisfied with the garland, Nadeko decided to polish it again. The garland has n pieces numbered from 1 to n from left to right, and the i-th piece has a colour si, denoted by a lowercase English letter. Nadeko will repaint at most m of the pieces to give each of them an arbitrary new colour (still denoted by a lowercase English letter). After this work, she finds out all subsegments of the garland containing pieces of only colour c — Brother Koyomi's favourite one, and takes the length of the longest among them to be the Koyomity of the garland.

For instance, let's say the garland is represented by "kooomo", and Brother Koyomi's favourite colour is "o". Among all subsegments containing pieces of "o" only, "ooo" is the longest, with a length of 3. Thus the Koyomity of this garland equals 3.

But problem arises as Nadeko is unsure about Brother Koyomi's favourite colour, and has swaying ideas on the amount of work to do. She has q plans on this, each of which can be expressed as a pair of an integer mi and a lowercase letter ci, meanings of which are explained above. You are to find out the maximum Koyomity achievable after repainting the garland according to each plan.
input: The first line of input contains a positive integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1 500) — the length of the garland.
The second line contains n lowercase English letters s1s2... sn as a string — the initial colours of paper pieces on the garland.
The third line contains a positive integer q (1 ≤ q ≤ 200 000) — the number of plans Nadeko has.

The next q lines describe one plan each: the i-th among them contains an integer mi (1 ≤ mi ≤ n) — the maximum amount of pieces to repaint, followed by a space, then by a lowercase English letter ci — Koyomi's possible favourite colour.
output: Output q lines: for each work plan, output one line containing an integer — the largest Koyomity achievable after repainting the garland according to it.
note: In the first sample, there are three plans:
In the first plan, at most 1 piece can be repainted. Repainting the "y" piece to become "o" results in "kooomi", whose Koyomity of 3 is the best achievable;
In the second plan, at most 4 pieces can be repainted, and "oooooo" results in a Koyomity of 6;
In the third plan, at most 4 pieces can be repainted, and "mmmmmi" and "kmmmmm" both result in a Koyomity of 5.

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个正整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 1 500）——花环的长度。
第二行包含一个由 n 个小写英文字母 s1s2... sn 组成的字符串——花环上纸片的初始颜色。
第三行包含一个正整数 q（1 ≤ q ≤ 200 000）——Nadeko 拥有的方案数量。
接下来的 q 行每行描述一个方案：其中第 i 行包含一个整数 mi（1 ≤ mi ≤ n）——最多可以重新涂色的纸片数量，随后是一个空格，然后是一个小写英文字母 ci——Koyomi 可能喜欢的颜色。

output.ai: 输出 q 行：对于每个方案，输出一行，其中包含一个整数——按照该方案重新涂色花环后所能达到的最大 Koyomity。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，共有三个方案：
在第一个方案中，至多可以重新涂 1 个棋子。将“y”棋子重新涂成“o”后得到“kooomi”，其 Koyomity 为 3，这是能够达到的最佳结果；
在第二个方案中，至多可以重新涂 4 个棋子，得到“oooooo”，其 Koyomity 为 6；
在第三个方案中，至多可以重新涂 4 个棋子，得到“mmmmmi”和“kmmmmm”时，二者的 Koyomity 均为 5。

legend.ai: Nadeko 的生日就要到了！她为聚会装饰房间时，一条由石竹花形状的纸片组成的长花环被挂在了墙上的显眼位置。Koyomi 哥哥一定会喜欢的！

不过，Nadeko 对这条花环仍不满意，于是决定再次打磨它。花环上有 n 个纸片，从左到右编号为 1 到 n，第 i 个纸片的颜色为 si，用一个小写英文字母表示。Nadeko 最多可以重新涂 m 个纸片，并将每个纸片涂成任意的新颜色（仍用小写英文字母表示）。完成后，她找出了花环中所有仅包含颜色 c 的纸片的子段，其中 c 是 Koyomi 哥哥最喜欢的颜色，并将其中最长子段的长度称为这条花环的 Koyomity。
例如，假设花环表示为“kooomo”，而 Koyomi 哥哥最喜欢的颜色是“o”。在所有仅包含“o”色纸片的子段中，“ooo”最长，长度为 3。因此，这条花环的 Koyomity 等于 3。
但是，Nadeko 不确定 Koyomi 哥哥最喜欢的颜色，而且对于要进行多少工作也有不同的想法。她有 q 个计划，每个计划都可以表示为一对整数 mi 和小写字母 ci，其含义如上所述。你需要求出按照每个计划重新涂色后能够达到的最大 Koyomity。
